limitations: Task-scoped total attempt limit with fixed zero delay on the recorded native Jenkins runtime only.
Persistent missing-revision failure and first-attempt success are observed; no transient-recovery, delay, backoff, cancellation, timeout or failure-filter claim.
The observer counts actual native checkout executions and identifies the final error origin without modifying the generated pipeline.
Generic target registry support, cross-target equivalence and portable execution are not promoted.
